scripts.build: npm run build:chrome && npm run build:firefox
scripts.build:chrome: vite build --mode chrome --outDir dist/chrome && node scripts/write-manifest.mjs chrome dist/chrome
scripts.build:firefox: vite build --mode firefox --outDir dist/firefox && node scripts/write-manifest.mjs firefox dist/firefox
scripts.build:chrome:test: vite build --mode chrome-test --outDir dist/chrome-test && node scripts/write-manifest.mjs chrome dist/chrome-test
scripts.test:ci: npm run build && npm run build:chrome:test && playwright test
scripts.test:build: npm run build && npm run build:chrome:test && npm test
scripts.test:firefox:e2e:build: npm run build:firefox && npm run test:firefox:e2e
scripts.test:all: npm run build && npm run build:chrome:test && npm test && npm run test:firefox:e2e
scripts.evidence: npm run build:chrome:test && playwright test -c playwright.evidence.config.ts --pass-with-no-tests
